notes: Comment-to-DM auto-reply (official Meta Private Replies API — no password bots). SETUP: 1) Meta app dashboard -> Webhooks -> subscribe 'comments' field to https://<n8n-domain>/webhook/affiliate/ig-comments with META_VERIFY_TOKEN. 2) Grant the app instagram_manage_comments + instagram_manage_messages (Facebook Login flow; dev mode is enough for your own account). 3) Set env: META_VERIFY_TOKEN, IG_USER_ID, IG_ACCESS_TOKEN, DM_KEYWORDS (include digital videos' keywords too, e.g. RSVP), DM_REPLY_TEMPLATE, DM_DEFAULT_LINK, DM_LINK_MAP_JSON, DM_DIGITAL_LINK_MAP_JSON, DM_DIGITAL_TEMPLATE. Two lanes: a media in DM_DIGITAL_LINK_MAP_JSON gets the own-product template with NO affiliate disclosure; everything else keeps the affiliate template + disclosure. The DM always ends with the affiliate disclosure on the affiliate lane; price/offer text can never be sent.
